# `core` dialect

## `core.delay`

A one-step delay register (sec 20 delay<T>): `current` = `init` on the first evaluation, thereafter the `next` from the PREVIOUS evaluation.

core.delay(%init, %next) -> %current. A one-evaluation delay/register (audio delay lines, TAA history taps): %current is %init on the first-ever evaluation, thereafter the %next of the PREVIOUS evaluation. The cell PERSISTS across evaluations (it does not reset on region re-entry). Structurally identical to core.state; the distinction is the executor's update timing (CEIR-5z).

## `core.history`

A depth-N history buffer (sec 20 history<T>): a delay line keeping the previous `depth` values (default 1).

core.history(%init, %next) -> %current, with an optional int `depth` attribute (RESERVED vocabulary; ABSENT = 1, PRESENT must be an Int >= 1 -- validated trait-generically by the CEIR-5d verifier as StateDepthInvalid). A ring of the previous `depth` values (GI/exposure histories); the cell PERSISTS across evaluations (it does not reset on region re-entry). ## `core.state`

An explicit persistent state cell (sec 20 state<T>): `current` = `init` on the first evaluation of the enclosing region instance, thereafter the previous `next`.

core.state(%init, %next) -> %current. The sec 20 state<T> primitive: %current is %init on the FIRST-EVER evaluation of the op and the previous evaluation's %next thereafter. The cell is PER STATIC OP INSTANCE and PERSISTS across evaluations -- it does NOT reset on region re-entry. StateEdge -> %next (the last operand) is the feedback edge. NOT Pure: each instance is a distinct cell. Executor semantics land at CEIR-5z.
